consequence.statement: Certificate renewal requests for proxies deployed at the same time will now be distributed with randomized jitter (±approximately 15 minutes around the default 12-hour renewal period) instead of occurring simultaneously.

assertion.statement: Environment variable `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER` was added with default value `0.01` to introduce randomized jitter in certificate renewal timing, preventing synchronized renewal requests across proxies.
